narr: Deep monsoon moisture remained over northern Arizona with several flash floods form the heavy rain.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in main side canyons that flow into Marble Canyon and the Colorado River just west of Navajo Bridge. The two named side canyons were Soap Creek and Jackass.

Heavy rain from a thunderstorm caused flooding on State Route 260 on the south side of Show Low. A car got stuck in the high water. Flooding was also reported east of Show Low near Highway 60 and Little Mormon Lake Road meet and on to the Second Knoll Shooting Range (Forest Road 206).
lsr: FLASH FLOODING REPORTED IN SOAP CREEK AND JACKASS CANYONS, AND OTHER AREA SLOT CANYONS.
FLOODING ON SR 260 SOUTH SIDE OF SHOW LOW. CAR STUCK IN HIGH WATER.
